name: mzi_node
description: Thermo-optic 2x2 MZI node: two optimised 2x2 MMIs joined by the Table-1 s-bend routing, with two top-arm heaters. The middle heater sets the coupling phase theta (3/6/10 dB), the input heater sets the external phase phi. S = t^4 * S_MMI @ diag(e^{i theta},1) @ S_MMI @ diag(e^{i phi},1). Temperatures are the heater RISE (K) above ambient.
